10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6737|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6737|7b1bcef4.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|7b1bcef4.text: The Deadmines can be found beneath Moonbrook in the south of Westfall.

6737|d352a290.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|d352a290.text: Once the greatest gold production center in the human lands, the Dead Mines are now inhabited by the Defias Brotherhood, who have turned the dark tunnels into their private sanctum. It is rumored that the thieves have conscripted the clever goblins to help them build something terrible at the bottom of the mines - but what that may be is still uncertain. Rumor has it that the way into the Deadmines lies through the quiet, unassuming village of Moonbrook.

1003-progress.name: Unknown
1003-progress.text:
You hear singing coming from Buzzbox 525.

"Though crawler wine's shweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine ish grand. There's nothing sho dear, as a thistle bear beer, and shoon I shall have shome on hand!"

The hatch is open and awaits the 4 grizzled scalps as you hear the song repeated over and over.
1003-progress.title: Buzzbox 525

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4812-progress.name: Unknown
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

98042-accept.name: Laurana
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea
